propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state that the close precheck requires a MERGED commit reachable from HEAD, when the implementation (_referencing_commit_exists) scans all history reachable from current HEAD regardless of merge status.
The close precheck is conditional and fires only when file_impact is recorded and the completion-verification gate is enabled, but the docs present it as unconditional.
The precheck accepts a rebar-ticket trailer for the ticket or any transitive descendant in the accepted_ids subtree, but the docs imply it checks only the ticket itself.

AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md omit documentation of 'rebar transition <id> in_progress closed --ref <sha>' as the sanctioned way to close a stacked story against its own commit without moving the worktree.
The land-before-close ordering is enforced by the Verified +1 policy rule, not by the precheck mechanism, but the docs misattribute the ordering to the precheck.
